name: Hansol Technics Co., Ltd.
summary: Hansol Technics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic components and materials in South Korea and internationally. The company offers power module devices, such as televisions inverters, converters, switch mode power supply products, mobile phones, wireless charging modules, automotive electronic components, solar inverters, and home appliances. It also provides light emitting diode (LED) sapphire materials, including ingot and wafer products; solar modules and silicon ingot/wafer technology products; and LED lighting products.
